blocks.x: Cyber & Zero-Trust for Retail & Consumer Banking — zero-trust by architecture, not by slide — identity, detection, resilience and ai security in one program applied to the retail & consumer banking operating unit of Banking & Financial Services.

Retail banks fight on experience and cost per account: onboarding friction, service resolution and cross-sell precision decide share of wallet. The machinery underneath — decisioning, document intelligence, contact platforms — is where Achala IT Solutions engineers advantage.

items: Credential stuffing, SIM-swap and social engineering beat static MFA; fraud losses concentrate in digital channels.
Account opening abandons at KYC and document stages; manual checks take days while fintechs approve in minutes. Drop-off concentrates exactly where policy risk is highest.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Zero-Trust Architecture & Implementation, Cyber Resilience & Incident Recovery, AI Security & Model Protection from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Account opening and KYC, Payment disputes and exceptions, Contact-center resolution) on Achala Sentinel and Achala Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — KYC/AML directives among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Identity as the perimeter — workforce, customer and machine identities on one governed plane.
Secure at the control plane — posture, workload and data security engineered into the platform.
Secure the models themselves — prompt-injection defense, agent containment and AI red-teaming.
behavioral biometrics, step-up auth and device intelligence (account-takeover losses down 30-45%)

blocks.caption: Regimes shaping this capability
rows: customer due diligence with periodic refresh duties
strong customer authentication with friction trade-offs
ICT risk, incident reporting, resilience testing and third-party oversight obligations with supervisory scrutiny
